objective: Full-batch normalized pre-BN output MSE on the same 500 fit calibration images, no labels, no ridge and no weight decay. This differs from the original ridge solution; a Q-only Adam control uses the same steps/objective.
selection: Lowest FIT objective including initialization, recorded independently per run; report final and best-fit losses. Evaluate the selected artifact on 500 separate check images only after optimization. No initialization or checkpoint selection on check/validation/test; all random starts reported.
scope: One discovery Q parent, two layers at the frozen all-Q-selected widths. Compare PHM4 init from exact Q embedding, saved dense-oracle SVD and three random seeds. All PHM starts have identical real parameter counts; each has 64 additional basis parameters over Q. This is a local optimizer/initialization diagnostic, not a matched-original-budget quality gain or full-network fine-tuning. No new n search, test or classification evaluation.
